PUNJAB SILK WORMS (REGULATION AND CONTROL) RULES,
1972
[Gazette of Punjab, Part I,
29th December 1972]
No. S. O. F(Ext) XXII‑4/71.‑In exercise
of the powers conferred by section 8 of the Punjab Silk Worms (Regulation and
Control) Ordinance, 1972, the Governor of the Punjab is pleased to make the
following rules :‑‑
PART I‑PRELIMINARY
1. (1) These
rules may be called the Punjab Silk Worms
(Regulation and Control) Rules, 1972.
(2) They shall come Into force
at once.
2. In these rules, unless the context otherwise
requires the following expressions shall have the meanings hereby respectively
assigned to them, that is to say t‑
(a) "Appendix" means
an Appendix to these rules;
(b) "Application" means an application in
the prescribed form append ed to these rules ;
(c) "Ordinance" means the Punjab Silk Worms
(Regulation and Control) Ordinance, 1972 ; and
(d) "Organisation" means Sericulture
Organization of the Forest Department.
PART 11‑GENERAL
3. An application made for the supply of Silk seeds
under these rules shall remain valid during the Silk Worms rearing period of
the season in which it is made.
4. Application for the supply of Silk Worms may be made to the Deputy Director, Sericulture.
(ii) The Assistant Director,
Sericulture.
(iii) The Entomologist
(Sericulture).
(iv) The Divisional Forest
Officer.
(v) The Sericulture Development Officer, and
(vi) any other officer duly authorised by Government.
5. The officers named below shall have the power to
enter and search, under section 4 of the Ordinance,‑
(i) Deputy Director,
Sericulture
(ii) Assistant Director,
Sericulture ;
(iii) Entomologist
(Sericulture)1
(iv) Sericulture Development Officer 1
(v) Sericulture Inspectors
(vi) Seed Examiner ; and
NO Sericulture Supervisor.
PART III
6. Subject to rule 10 no
person, authority, or Department other than the Organization shall produce and
supply silk worms.
7. Except the person, who is
supplied silk worms by the Organization, no other person shall rear silk worms.
8. The price of the silk worms shall
be fixed by the Government from time to time.
9. Government may, on
application made to it and on payment of such fees as may be fixed, apply silk
worms, if‑
(l) the applicant is an old bona fide bearer ;
(ii) the applicant possesses
adequate accommodation of the rearing of silk worms ;
(iii) the applicant carries out
proper disinfection of the rearing huts etc. according to the instructions
issued by the Organization ; and
(iv) the applicant possesses or
acquires adequates mulberry plants to feed the silk worms.
10. Government may authorise
any person to perform the functions of supplying silk worms on the following
terms and conditions, if he‑
(/) has sufficient experience
in the field of sericulture ;
(li) makes payment of fee
determined by Government from time to time in advance ;
(iii) makes payment of the
price of silk worms at the rate fixed by Government in advance to the
organization in case ft is Government property ;
(iv) undertakes to supply silk
worms only to such persons as are recommended by the Organization ; and ,
(v) undertakes to supply the
silk worms at the rates fixed by the Government from time to time.
